title: A Letters for the Bakery
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Bram Zhou, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
